messages:
Alice: Quick preflight for onboarding ceres-7b into the catalog — need: definitive weights S3 path, tokenizer quirks to watch, serving config suggestion (max_seq, kv_cache), and a perf plan (batch sizes / seq lengths). Can people drop answers + who can run perf?

Ben: Weights are at s3://redwood-models/ceres/ceres-7b/v1/ceres-7b-fp16.pt (fp16) and s3://redwood-models/ceres/ceres-7b/v1/ceres-7b-ggml-q4_0.bin (quant q4_0). Use fp16 for baseline, quant for cost analysis.

Carla: Tokenizer note — it's sentencepiece with legacy <s> and </s>. We saw a mismatch earlier where tests added an extra BOS. Sample: `tokenizer.encode("Hello") -> [1, 234, 2]` where 1 is <s>. We should not double-add BOS in prefill.

Ben: Right — set tokenizer config: `add_bos: false`, `add_eos: true` in the serving manifest. Also model expects pad_id=0; ensure that maps.

Ida: For config validation, do we have a reference manifest pattern? I can run a quick schema check if someone posts the manifest draft.

Alice: Pasting a minimal manifest we used previously (note: placeholder values):
```
model_name: "ceres-7b"
weights: "s3://redwood-models/ceres/ceres-7b/v1/ceres-7b-fp16.pt"
max_seq_len: 2048
kv_cache: true
continuous_batching: true
tokenizer: 
  type: sentencepiece
  add_bos: false
  add_eos: true
  pad_id: 0
```

Jo: I can run the perf matrix. Proposed matrix: batch_sizes = [1,4,8,16], seq_lens = [512,1024,2048]. Run baseline (fp16) and quant (q4_0) for cost numbers. Use concurrent workers=4 and threads=8. Will post CSV. When should I start?

Ben: Ack. Add an extra test with `prefill`=true vs false for long contexts — we saw prefill shaping latency. Also for batch sizing, test both `prefill_batch_limit` of 4 and 8 to see throughput/latency tradeoffs.

Carla: Metric targets we expect for catalog entry: p50 gen latency <= 65ms for batch=1 at seq=1 (single token), p90 < 120ms. Throughput target: >100 tok/s for batch=8 at seq=512 (baseline hw: A100 80GB). If we can't meet those we should mark as "heavy" in catalog.

Jo: Noted. I'll run p50/p90 and throughput (tokens/s). Also collecting memory peak. I'll run with: `./perf_runner --model ceres-7b --weights <path> --batch 1,4,8,16 --seq 512,1024,2048 --workers 4 --threads 8 --kv_cache true --record csv`. Will kick off in ~30m.

DevOps Bot: artifact-scan: ceres-7b-fp16.pt — size 13.4GB, checksum OK, missing license metadata (catalog field `license` required).

Alice: Good catch — license should be 'apache-2.0' for this one. I'll update the repo entry.

Ida: For schema validation, here's a quick jq check I use: `cat manifest.yaml | yq -o=json | jq 'has("weights") and .max_seq_len <= 4096 and .tokenizer.add_bos == false'` — works for basic gating. Want me to add a CI job to run that on PRs?

Alice: Please do, would be great. Keeps us from shipping broken tokenization.

Ben: Small heads-up: earlier smoke run failed with OOM on batch=16, seq=2048 on our test A100 small farm — probably due to some hidden attention cache retention in the fp16 binary. If Jo hits OOM, try prefill=false or reduce prefill_batch_limit. Log snippet from last run:
```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 1.2 GiB (GPU 0; 39.6 GiB total capacity; 35.1 GiB already allocated).
  at /workspace/runtime/alloc.cc:123
```

Jo: I'll watch memory. I'll do adaptive runs: start with batch 1 then increase until OOM then note the threshold. Also will run quant model on CPU for cost baseline since q4_0 binary is CPU optimized.

Carla: One more tokenizer quirk — our eval harness trims leading <s> only if `add_bos:false` is present. If some downstream customers rely on `add_bos:true` we should document the break. Add a note in catalog doc.

Alice: Agreed — add to catalog notes: "Tokenizer: sentencepiece, add_bos=false; downstream users removing BOS may need to update prompts."

Jo: Will post run summary here with CSV attachment (p50,p90,mem,throughput) and a short verdict: pass / marginal / fail vs the targets. ETA ~2h.

Ben: If perf is marginal, we should try a recompilation with FlashAttention v2 kernels and rerun. I'll open an infra ticket if needed.

Alice: Thanks all. Ping here when runs are uploaded. :thumbsup: 

Jo: Uploaded results — summary: fp16 baseline meets p50 target for batch=1 seq=1 (p50=52ms, p90=95ms), OOM at batch=16 seq=2048 (same as Ben), throughput for batch=8 seq=512 = 118 tok/s. Quant (q4_0) on CPU much cheaper but ~3x slower latency. CSV: (attached)

Carla: Looks good. Recommendation: onboard as `standard` with note about long-context OOM risk and tokenizer config.

Alice: I'll update the catalog entry and submit the PR with manifest + license + notes. Ida — can you add the schema CI job to the onboarding PR?

Ida: Yep, will add the check.

Ben: I'll follow up on a FlashAttention recompile ticket if we want to push better long-context mem behavior.

Alice: Closing loop — thanks everyone. If any perf follow-ups needed, reply here.
